acceptanceCriteria.description: Acceptance criteria, one line each. Replaces the list.

archived.description:

type.description: A task type by name or ID. "" clears it.

post.description: Save a view of a space's tasks: a name, the task list's query, list or board, and columns. Views are yours alone unless shared: true, which needs the right to edit the space's tasks. pinned: true puts it in your own sidebar. Needs "See tasks" where it acts.

parameters.description: The workspace the operation acts in, by id or slug. A target in another workspace is not found.
parameters.name: workspace

parameters.description: Your id for this change, kept the same when you retry it: a retry with the same id and input is answered once, with replayed: true; the same id with other input is a conflict. A change without one is refused.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

delete.description:
true deletes the view. Built-in views can't be deleted; unpin them
instead.

expectedVersion.description:
The version from view_list or an earlier view_write. Leave it out to
change the current one.

fields.description:
The list columns to show: any of priority, key, status, details,
due, assignee, or "field:<id>" for a custom field. Leave it out to
keep them; [] shows only the title.

name.description: The new view's name, or a new name: 1 to 80 characters.

pinned.description:
true pins the view to your own sidebar, false unpins it. Nobody
else's sidebar changes.

projectId.description: The project's ID, link or key (such as "AWD").

query.description:
The task list's query, as view_list shows it for other views: keys
such as q, statusId, semanticCategory, priority, assigneeActorId
("me" means whoever opens it, "none" unassigned), labelIds,
milestoneId, blocked, ready, claimed, dueBefore, includeDone, sort
(priority, updated, number, due), groupBy, columnsBy and lanes. Values
are strings; several IDs are comma-separated. On a change it replaces
the whole query.

shared.description:
true shares the view with everyone in the project (needs the right
to edit its tasks); false keeps it yours alone. New views are yours
alone unless you say so.

view.description:
The view to change, pin or delete: its ID, its name, or a built-in's
key (my_tasks, ready_for_agents, blocked, recently_changed). Leave it
out to save a new view.

created.description: Whether this call saved a new view.

deleted.description: Whether this call deleted the view.

view.description:
The view as it is now (as view_list shows it, with its version).
Absent once it's deleted.
